The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

title: Rune
excerpt: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other — Rune is a small, fast text editor for the Mac. One scratch file in iCloud Drive is shared by all your Macs: saved as you type, and edits from two Macs are merged, never overwritten. Plain-text paste, Sublime Text's colors and keys, and Find in History.

title: Cakie
excerpt: Turn screen recordings into prompts for AI agents — Record your screen and talk it through, like a Loom. Cakie picks the frames that match your words, adds what you point at or draw, and turns it into one prompt for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. No more describing your screen.

title: Trophy MCP Servers
excerpt: Interact with Trophy from your favourite AI tools — Introducing Trophy's MCP servers. Use your favourite AI tools to configure gamified features and control your Trophy account without touching the dashboard.

title: Porch
excerpt: local project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding — Porch turns your Claude Code and Codex work into daily, weekly, and monthly summaries by project, with estimated task time and blockers. See sessions across terminals and editors, know which need your attention, track tokens and API-equivalent costs, and save summaries as Markdown to Obsidian or any folder. Open source, with no Porch account required. Session status and usage stay on your Mac; summaries use your installed, signed-in Claude Code or Codex.

title: OpenPilot
excerpt: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose — OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

title: Videorc
excerpt: Open source studio to record and go live everywhere at once. — Most capture tools are either too basic or too complex. Videorc is the third option: pick a scene, hit record, go live. Stream to YouTube, Twitch, Kick, X, TikTok, Instagram, or any RTMP server at once for free, while recording locally in up to 4K. Built with Rust and Electron, open source under AGPL-3.0. Pro adds live captions and Orcle, an AI that drafts chat replies and flags abuse but never posts on its own. macOS beta (Apple Silicon), Windows 11 alpha.

title: Refs
excerpt: Give Claude better references for your videos — Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

title: iwant
excerpt: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command — Host your own DeepSeek, Kimi, Minimax, MiMo, Step with with one command. iwant hunts across GCP regions for available GPUs, then handles provisioning, model downloads, and vLLM setup. One command gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an API key, and SSH access.

title: Together Link
excerpt: Use open models in your harness — Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

title: CodeKru Tools
excerpt: Free QA compilers, assignments, and test generators — Free QA automation tools: run Selenium and Playwright in the browser, generate test cases as CSV, convert Selenium to Playwright, and practice with live assignments.Free QA automation tools. Run Selenium and Playwright in the browser with no install, in Java, Python, or JavaScript. Practice on live assignments with instant feedback, generate test cases as CSV, and convert Selenium scripts to Playwright.

title: HaltState MCP
excerpt: Investigate AI agent activity from your MCP client — Ask what your AI agents did, find a customer interaction, follow its timeline and verify linked Proof Packs from your MCP client. Ten investigation tools bring activity search, evidence verification and exports into your existing workflow. Connect agents with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java or Rust; enforce policies before connected actions execute. Self-service signup and AI-assisted policy setup help you start with one action.

title: SafetyGraph

title: FPSOverlay
excerpt: Real time performance overlay for iOS through LiveContainer — FPSOverlay is a lightweight iOS gaming performance overlay for LiveContainer. Monitor FPS, CPU, GPU, RAM, battery, frame time, refresh rate, thermal state, and a live FPS graph while you play.

title: The Iweology Project
excerpt: Securing a Human-first future — Technology IS our future. But without a metric for truth, it defaults to extraction—bleeding corporate capital through code debt and fracturing the brain gestalt to harvest Attentional Currency. Iweo Global Inc. launches The Iweology Project: A Human-First Initiative. Driven by the universal equation D(n) <-> I(10-n), we provide an immutable mathematical correction for integrous intelligent technologies. Reclaim your sovereign agency. The digital grid is active.

title: Cluvia
excerpt: AI OS for companies that automates the whole process. — An AI OS that lets you deploy multi-agent teams structured like functional companies rather than managing a single conversational agent. Instead of prompting individual LLMs step-by-step, you select a company template (e.g., SEO Agency, Newsletter, Web Publisher, Automation Agency) and set a top-level goal. Cluvia instantiates a structured org chart: a CEO agent, mid-level manager agents, and specialist agents.

title: QR Island
excerpt: A free QR code studio with 25 3D islands — Make a free QR code for a link, Wi‑Fi, a contact card, WhatsApp and more, and watch it become the courtyard of one of 25 3D islands. No sign-up, codes never expire, PNG and SVG free. Pay only for print-size pictures, a video or an editable code.

title: SupaYatta
excerpt: Know when your AI agents need you, right from your notch — Stop checking whether your AI agents are done. SupaYatta shows Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode activity in your Mac's notch or a floating bar. Get alerts for finished turns, questions and approvals, preview replies, and jump back to the right session.

title: MacZentra
excerpt: Your Mac isn't full. It's cluttered. — Stop renting bloated Mac cleaners. MacZentra is a fast, native app that clears hidden junk and duplicates. Download today for a free scan.

title: TrueRev
excerpt: Real revenue. Verified by Stripe — Startups ranked by real MRR, verified straight from Stripe. Compare revenue and growth of SaaS, AI products and indie apps, and list yours for free.

title: Hydra
excerpt: Run a team of coding agents without wrecking your repo — Give Hydra one prompt and it splits the work across a team of coding agents running in parallel. Each agent gets its own git worktree and branch, and nothing lands until it clears gates: tests, screenshots, and a read-only review. Multi-step plans run in dependency order. Hydra never asks for your API key or reads your credentials. Open source, MIT.

title: How to Build an Emergency Fund From
